title: Comment on C-124 "May I restart Xcode's device service on the Mac? (fixes the…": What's the problem ?

anchor.label: May I restart Xcode's device service on the Mac? (fixes the phone test tool)

messages.text:
Fixed: Xcode's device service on the Mac had kept an old error, so the tool that drives the iPhone in our tests could not start.

- Since about 11:15Z that tool (WebDriverAgent) failed every start with "previously reported preparation errors", although the iPhone was plugged in, unlocked and Xcode's window showed no problem.
- The service had run for 7 days; restarting it (your yes at 11:52Z) cleared it: the tool started in 8 s.
- The phone test that finds the code behind the two slow spots (P-166) restarted at 11:54Z and runs about 1 hour.
- The earlier hung temperature reads may have the same cause (not confirmed).

What you need to do: nothing; keep the iPhone plugged in and don't touch it until about 12:55Z.
Ok, let's note it as incident and workaround.

Done: noted as an incident, "Xcode device service kept an old error" (I-251), with the workaround.

- Sign: the phone test tool fails every start with "previously reported preparation errors", though the iPhone is plugged in and unlocked.
- Workaround: with your OK, restart Xcode's device service on the Mac, then start the tool again; a re-plug or unlock does not help.
- Long-term: a toolsmith will make our tools spot this error and print the hint (never restart the service without your OK).
- The phone test is running now; the temperature reads work again too.

What you need to do: nothing.
